cl:deXZFQAs2R53SWg3LZm4ir.description: Selling our gorgeous, garage-kept 2014 Honda CR-V EX-L, which we purchased brand new from Gillman Honda in July 2014 with just 39 miles! It truly saddens us to sell it, but our family is growing, and we need something with a third row to accommodate our growing family. We have a clean and clear Texas title in hand, and we are the original owners. It is ready for its next lucky owner! Never smoked in, no accidents, no rust, and no pets. I am confident this is one of the cleanest examples on the market, as we have taken exceptionally great care of it in every way! All recommended maintenance services have been completed according to the dealership’s recommendations. We also have a complete file of all service records. The Honda CR-V is well known for its reliability, safety, comfort, and family-friendly design! What makes this one even more special is that it is the EX-L trim, which comes loaded with features that make driving more enjoyable, including heated power leather seats, a sunroof, an upgraded screen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, cruise control, automatic headlights, Bluetooth, AUX, USB, and many other great features! The Pearl White exterior still shines beautifully and is in excellent condition for its age, with no major or noticeable imperfections whatsoever. The black leather interior is spotless and still looks and smells like new, with virtually no wear at all. The tires are still in excellent condition, are nitrogen-filled, and include a road hazard warranty. Even the spare tire has never been used. It runs and drives extremely smoothly and powerfully. It gets more than 30 MPG and features an ECO mode that helps save even more fuel. It offers plenty of trunk space, with folding rear seats for additional cargo room. It comes with two original key fobs and a valet key, all original manuals and books, and the original window sticker from when we first purchased it.
